name: singlet_demux_sex_inference
title: Sex inference per cell and per donor
description: Calls each cell as female, male or ambiguous from XIST and chrY-linked expression, optionally aggregating calls to donors, and writes obs/sex_call and obs/sex_score. Use when a per-cell or per-donor sex label is needed for QC or sample identity checks. Do not use it to infer karyotype, loss of Y or ancestry, and do not treat its output as genotype-derived sex.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

layer.description: Raw UMI count layer; normalised internally to log1p counts per 10,000.

method.description: Scoring rule; pegasus_score is the published default.

donor_key.description: obs column giving donor or sample; enables donor-level calls. Null gives per-cell calls only.

truth_key.description: obs column with genotype-derived sex for evaluation only; adds accuracy metrics to the summary.

min_sex_umi.description: Cells with fewer sex-panel UMIs are called ambiguous.

pseudobulk_min_cells.description: Minimum cells for a donor or cluster to receive a donor-level call.

pegasus_score.description: Options for the pegasus_score method only.

female_genes.description: Female-associated gene symbols; XIST carries most of the signal.

male_genes.description: Y-linked gene symbols from the pegasus male set.

n_bins.description: Expression bins for background genes in signature scoring.

standardize.description: Standardise panel expression against the expression-bin background.

k_clusters.description: One-dimensional k-means clusters; 3 gives female, ambiguous and male.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for the one-dimensional k-means split.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/sex_call. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Counts per call (female, male, ambiguous), donor-level call count, and accuracy when truth_key is set.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
